svg.text: the roots: from the runs root and
the run ID, never from a stored path
the stage freeze has its own pool
10 s at most for one run
route reads never take its slots; a freeze that
stalls holds the writer 10 s, then no stages
one request for a job's files, in this order

with a state: present, not_yet, absent,

its own threads: not the writer's,
nor the runner's, so a stuck mount
each listing or read: 5 s at most

svg.text: from the run's own folder, by run ID
one folder at a time, O_NOFOLLOW,
each one yours; then a regular file
of yours: no FIFO, no device
a part over 255 bytes, a name over 4096

svg.text: a NUL in the first 8 KiB: not text
?tail= or one Range: 1 MiB at most
.command.run, read with a shell lexer, not a line pattern:
every assignment value is hidden, here-documents included
